claims.physical: Name-level candidate inventory only; no general marker-body, digest, source-completeness, or aggregation conservation claim. Listings were not an atomic locked snapshot.
claims.index: Ordinary checksum-bound availability reads; pointer and generation verification is not a whole-history source/physical re-verification.
claims.partial_ladder: Some rungs have terminal-looking names and others do not; days incomplete at every rung are separately visible in rung states.
claims.cutoff: All eight lanes shadow at captured deployed process; no owned lease for the cutoff group at the read-only ledger snapshot. Definitions remain enabled.
claims.burn_in: Generic successful schedules do not count as publication advancement. Six-product physical proof is separate.
